author: ZelenskyyUa
text:
Today, Commander-in-Chief of the Armed Forces of Ukraine Mykhailo Drapatyi reported on a new step by our manufacturers – another interceptor against Russian jet-powered drones has been successfully tested. A “shahed” was hit successfully, but some aspects of controlling the interceptor still need to be refined. The work continues – it will take some more time. I thank the developers for their efforts! 

We also discussed our further military operations and our long-range capabilities. I am grateful to the Ministry of Defense of Ukraine for its thorough approach to supporting these operations. Together with Yevhenii Khmara and the Commander-in-Chief of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, we identified the next priority targets, the necessary resources, and the required preparations. The results of our long-range impact on the oil base underpinning Russia’s war are quite significant, and this is exactly what gives diplomacy the necessary potential. 

Ukraine is ready to take its de-escalatory steps, but our partners must ensure that Russia acts in good faith in implementing its own de-escalatory steps regarding our critical infrastructure – reliably and for the long term. I thank everyone who is helping! I thank every one of our units for their accuracy!
